functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.access5a_prevent_evidence_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Term acceptances are append-only';
END $function$

END;
$function$
